scripts.build: vite build && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --outfile=dist/server.cjs && node -e "console.log('Current backend entry: server.ts'); console.log('Output directory: dist/'); console.log('Generated files:', require('fs').readdirSync('dist')); if (!require('fs').existsSync('dist/server.cjs')) { console.error('FATAL ERROR: dist/server.cjs is missing!'); process.exit(1); } else { console.log('BUILD SUCCESS'); console.log('FOUND dist/server.cjs'); }"
